reply_text:
One merge blocker:

*P1 — Team and archive plans reject every nonempty upload* (`src/plans.js:11`). `entry.quotaKiB << 10` uses JavaScript’s 32-bit bitwise arithmetic, so both quotas become **0**, rather than 200 GiB and 2 TiB. Confirmed that a 1-byte upload to an empty account is rejected on both plans.

Use `entry.quotaKiB * 1024` and add quota/upload tests for both paid plans before merging.

All 4 existing tests pass; they only exercise quota enforcement on the free plan. No code changed.
